title: SWE-Nexus: Automated Composition of Software Engineering Tasks from Test Execution
abstract: arXiv:2610.20038v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Historical code changes provide convenient task boundaries, but do not identify which production functions selected tests exercise or support composing validated behaviors beyond a single change. We present SWE-Nexus, a fully automated pipeline that constructs repository-level implementation tasks from test execution. Four construction agents select tests, adapt tracing and evaluation protocols to each repository, and generate behavioral specifications. For each selected test file, tracing records an observed execution footprint of production function bodies. A scope is retained only if all expected scoring points pass in the original repository and masking the traced bodies causes at least one failure or error. Compatible scopes are composed deterministically, with shared functions counted once and every constituent test file revalidated under the complete combined mask. The benchmark contains 600 tasks from 105 repositories across six

translated_title: SWE-Nexus：从测试执行中自动构建软件工程任务
translated_abstract: 历史代码变更提供了便利的任务边界，但无法识别所选测试究竟执行了哪些生产函数，也无法支持超越单次变更的已验证行为组合。我们提出了 SWE-Nexus，这是一个完全自动化的流水线，能够从测试执行中构建仓库级的实现任务。四个构建智能体负责选择测试、为每个仓库适配追踪与评估协议，并生成行为规范。对于每个选定的测试文件，追踪会记录生产函数体的观测执行足迹。仅当在原始仓库中所有预期评分点均通过、且屏蔽被追踪的函数体会导致至少一个失败或错误时，该作用域才会被保留。兼容的作用域以确定性的方式进行组合，共享函数仅计算一次，并且每个组成测试文件都会在完整的组合屏蔽下重新验证。该基准测试包含来自六个（领域）的 105 个仓库的 600 个任务……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: SWE-Nexus 是一个完全自动化的流水线，通过追踪测试执行中生产函数的足迹、验证屏蔽效果并确定性组合兼容作用域，自动构建出涵盖 105 个仓库、共 600 个任务的仓库级软件工程实现基准。
